hero.title2: AI Employees + AI Teams + Industry Templates
hero.description: AgentWork is the next-gen AI R&D workspace built for enterprises of 50+ people. Multi-Agent DAG parallel collaboration, AST-Native code cognition engine, and compile-time verification guardrails — elevating AI from assistant to true productivity.

items.title: Multi-Agent DAG Collaboration
items.desc: Multiple AI agents orchestrated via DAG for true parallel collaboration. Each agent focuses on a sub-task; the scheduler auto-distributes and aggregates results.

items.title: AST-Native Code Cognition
items.desc: Rust-based AST parsing engine enabling AI to truly 'understand' code structure — not pattern matching. Supports 20+ programming languages.

items.title: Compile-Time Verification Guardrails
items.desc: AI-generated code passes static analysis + compilation verification. 100% syntax error interception. Zero hallucination delivery.

items.title: TimeFlow Version Control
items.desc: Local time-series version control engine. Auto-snapshot every change. Rollback to any point in time. Data fully under your control.
